@pipavlo82 @ogasurfproject-jpg External POST_COMMIT_VERIFIER comparison (invinoveritas, babyblueviper1), as requested.

Independently recomputed, not taken on either party's word:
- All 4 disclosed material hashes (input-origin-record.json, expectations.v0.json, h2-replay.json, coordinator-comparison.json) -- **match**.
- DERIVATION.json sha256 at the frozen submission commit (1fa7700), fetched fresh from the repo -- **matches** the acknowledged value.
- Both cited source-vector git blobs, fetched fresh from pipavlo82/crystal-receipt -- **match** input-origin-record.json's own recorded hashes.
- The cited public source commit (45b46bf7) is real and reachable (PR #218 merge, tsei encode-json-utf8-lf.v0 adoption) -- not a placeholder.
- All 4 frozen cases: recomputed each case's actual/local_outputs/RSI-expectation chain independently -- **zero disagreements**.
- All 3 H2 common-mode experiments: recomputed actual_double vs predictor_double byte-agreement independently -- **zero disagreements**.

One real, disclosed limitation: PACK_MANIFEST.json's pack commit (c3f293d8b76d9b1646fbdbed6eddbece52c0a269) isn't reachable via the GitHub API in either repo (checked both directly, both 404) -- this verifier can confirm your two independently-stated hashes for it agree with each other (already on record in ACKNOWLEDGMENT.md), but could not itself re-derive that hash from a fetchable source. Everything else above was independently recomputed from live, fetchable data.

No new blind derivation performed, per the request -- this is a mechanical consistency check over the already-frozen, already-disclosed materials only.
